issues.title: OpenRAC: Ratchet & Clank 2: Locked and Loaded stopped
issues.author: AngelMM99
issues.body:
**


**
When testing the European version of Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando (Ratchet & Clank 2), I noticed that the game has improved compared to previous builds. Previously, Ratchet couldn't move at all, but now he can move a little before the game eventually crashes. Additionally, dialogue boxes are not displayed. The American version works perfectly, so this issue seems to be specific to the European version.

What happened: it ended with exit code -805306369, without a crash…
